name: thesis-mcwm-decision-scale-v6
decision_scale_mode: Root mean square of the two candidate models' average absolute backup errors on the stopping split; the same scale is used for both families
primary_comparison: Balanced decision scale versus unchanged decision scale and a fresh normalized control; same two seeds, three source conditions, budgets and ten test days
interpretation: Prospective development variant motivated by v5 diagnostics; previously used evaluation days, not independent confirmation; retain all positive and negative outcomes
unchanged: Proper predictive fitting, frozen critic reference, two decoding draws, source actor mixture, model fraction, normalized trust backup, ensemble size, refresh schedule and deployment execution layer
